Land ceiling determines the maximum land which can be held by

Chakbandi of land means to aggregate the divided and broken land .
The land within area less than 1 hectare; is called marginal land holding

Co-operative Credit Organisation started first time in 1904.
Primary Co-operative Committees provide credit for short period.
State Co-operative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks provide
credit for long period.
Land Development Bank provides long-term loans.
Land Development Bank was established in the year 1919 in the form
of Land Mortgage Bank.
